about.title: An engineer who ships autonomous agents into production.
body: Systems Engineer from UNIMET with a final degree project awarded with honors, specializing in Artificial Intelligence. I have a proven track record building full-stack architectures and autonomous agents that have driven major operational cost reductions in the banking sector.

I work as a freelance engineer using the latest AI development tooling (primarily Claude Code) to design, orchestrate and ship production software faster than traditional teams. My core is n8n workflow orchestration, the Google Cloud ecosystem, and scalable software.
